senses.gloss:
दृंह् I. €1 P. (दृंहति, दृंहित)
—1 To make firm, strengthen.
—2 To make fast, fasten.
—3 To fortify. ━II. €1 Ā. (दृहते)
—1 To be firm.
—2 To grow or increase.

दृह्, दृंह् €1 P. (दर्हति, दृंहति)
—1 To be fixed or firm.
—2 To grow, increase.
—3 To prosper.
—4 To fasten.

दृंहणम् Ved. Fortifying, fastening, making firm &c. तां त्वा नितत्नि
 केशेभ्यो दृंहणाय खनामसि Av. 6. 136. 1.

दृंहित p. p.
—1 Made firm, strengthened.
—2 Grown, increased.

दृन्फूः f.
—1 A snake.
—2 Thunder-bolt.
—3 A wheel. ━m. The sun.

दृन्भूः m.
—1 The thunderbolt (of Indra).
—2 The sun.
—3 A king.
—4 Yama, god of death (अन्तक).
